review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve a newer span during cross-context cleanup**

When a cross-context callback for span A runs while the destination context already has another Braintrust span B active, the reset raises `ValueError` and this fallback unconditionally overwrites B's `braintrust_span` entry. The OTEL span and `braintrust.parent` entries still point at B, so the context becomes inconsistent: `get_current_span_info()` returns the `NonRecordingSpan` instead of B and `current_span()` becomes a no-op, dropping any logs made through it until the context is restored. Clear only the span associated with the failed token rather than an unrelated active value.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Run the regression in the OTEL nox session**

In the checked `.github/workflows/checks.yaml` nox matrix, this test is never run with OTEL installed: `test_core` first asserts all vendor packages (including `opentelemetry`) are absent, so this function always takes its skip, while `test_otel` in `py/noxfile.py:923-932` installs OTEL but invokes only `braintrust/test_otel.py`. Include this file in that session (or move the regression there), otherwise CI cannot detect this fix regressing on any supported Python version.
